title: Late-Payment Rate Schedule by Comfort Club Payment Record — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
The rate of a late-payment charge on Repair and Emergency Service Calls is stated per charging period of 30 days. It depends on the customer's Comfort Club agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements and on whether that agreement has carried a Comfort Club late fee. The records read are the agreement's status and the late fee entries on its dues ledger.

**Schedule.** The rate is:

- 1 percent for each charging period for a customer whose active agreement has carried no Comfort Club late fee in the last 24 months;
- 1.25 percent for any other customer with an active agreement;
- the class's 1.5 percent for every other customer.

| Customer | Comfort Club late fees in the last 24 months | Rate per charging period |
|---|---|---|
| Active agreement | None | 1 percent |
| Active agreement | One or more | 1.25 percent |
| No active agreement | — | 1.5 percent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical $500.00 balance, 2 periods)

| Customer | Rate | Balance multiplied by rate and periods |
|---|---|---|
| Member with a clean dues record | 1 percent | $10.00 |
| Member with one late fee 8 months ago | 1.25 percent | $12.50 |
| Non-member | 1.5 percent | $15.00 |

A member whose agreement lapsed has no active agreement and is charged at 1.5 percent.
